items.title: Mannesmann Energy公布ADNOC NEB CPP油气设施升级计划
items.title_en: Mannesmann Energy unveils ADNOC NEB CPP oil and gas facilities upgrade initiative
items.summary: Mannesmann Energy在ADIPEC 2026披露与ADNOC合作升级Al-Nouf、Rumaitha及Shanayel的NEB CPP设施，以提升处理能力、资产完整性和运营可靠性，并计划签署项目实施协议。尚未宣布已签EPC合同或投资金额。
items.summary_en: At ADIPEC 2026, Mannesmann Energy disclosed an initiative with ADNOC to upgrade NEB CPP facilities at Al-Nouf, Rumaitha and Shanayel, aiming to enhance capacity, asset integrity and operational resilience. The company plans to sign an implementation agreement; no signed EPC award or project value was reported.
items.why_it_matters: 项目明确针对既有油气设施升级，但目前仍处协议推进阶段。
items.why_it_matters_en: The initiative targets existing oil and gas facilities but remains at the proposed implementation-agreement stage.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注工业管道、阀门、机电工程、检修及专业施工供应链。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor industrial piping, valves, MEP works, maintenance and specialist construction supply opportunities.
items.stage: 项目公布／实施协议待签

items.title: 阿曼—海湾电网400kV互联工程建设完成约35%
items.title_en: Oman–GCC 400 kV power interconnection reaches approximately 35% completion
items.summary: 阿曼通往海湾互联电网的工程已完成约35%，投资超过2.689亿阿曼里亚尔，包括Ibri至阿联酋Al Sila约530公里400kV输电连接、Ibri与Baynunah变电站及控制保护系统，预计2027年底投运。属于在建项目进展，不是新增授标。
items.summary_en: Construction of Oman's direct interconnection with the GCC electricity grid is approximately 35% complete, representing investment above RO268.9 million. Works include a roughly 530 km, 400 kV connection between Ibri and Al Sila in the UAE, substations at Ibri and Baynunah, and control and protection systems, with operation targeted by end-2027. This is an update on an existing project, not a new award.
items.why_it_matters: 跨境能源设施仍有配套需求，但应区分剩余工程和已采购设备。
items.why_it_matters_en: Cross-border grid development may generate ancillary demand, but remaining works must be separated from already-procured packages.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注变电设备、线路安装、调试与后续运维服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor substation equipment, line installation, commissioning and future maintenance services.

items.title: 阿曼塞拉莱30亿美元AI数据园区探索可再生能源供应合作
items.title_en: Oman's USD3 billion Salalah AI data park explores renewable energy supply partnership
items.summary: 阿曼塞拉莱拟议的30亿美元AI数据园区正研究与合作伙伴开展太阳能、风电、储能及电网接入合作，以支持最高约400MW的计算设施。当前属于合作意向与供能方案研究，不代表30亿美元工程合同或新授标。需与此前报道的Al Khadra Digital项目区分。
items.summary_en: A proposed USD3 billion AI data park in Salalah is exploring partnerships for solar, wind, battery storage and grid integration to serve a computing campus of up to approximately 400 MW. This remains an energy-supply partnership exploration, not a USD3 billion construction award. Its relationship to the previously reported Al Khadra Digital development requires clarification.
items.why_it_matters: 数据中心与新能源配套规模较大，但项目身份及建设包需独立核实。
items.why_it_matters_en: The data-centre and clean-power opportunity may be substantial, while project identity and construction packages require separate verification.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注数据中心供电、储能、冷却设备及工业建筑供应链。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor data-centre power, battery storage, cooling equipment and industrial construction supply.

items.title: 阿布扎比Gulf Cryo碳捕集设施计划数周内投产
items.title_en: Gulf Cryo's Abu Dhabi carbon capture plant expected to start production within weeks
items.summary: Gulf Cryo表示其阿布扎比碳捕集工厂预计在数周内投产，在既有拉斯海马设施基础上扩张工业碳捕集能力。公告没有披露新的施工招标或EPC合同价值。
items.summary_en: Gulf Cryo stated that its Abu Dhabi carbon-capture facility is expected to begin production within weeks, adding to its existing operation in Ras Al Khaimah. The announcement did not identify a new construction tender or EPC contract value.
items.why_it_matters: 处于接近运营的阶段，更适合跟踪设备服务及运营供应机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: The plant is approaching operation, making equipment services and operational supply more relevant than new construction bids.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注工业气体设备维护、碳捕集运营与技术合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor industrial-gas equipment maintenance, carbon-capture operations and technology partnerships.

items.title: 沙迦Shurooq展示文化旅游及酒店开发项目组合
items.title_en: Sharjah's Shurooq showcases heritage tourism and hospitality developments
items.category: 开发推广／部分既有项目
items.summary: 沙迦投资与发展局Shurooq展示包括Kalba Rock Art Centre、Heart of Sharjah、Al Faya Retreat扩建及与The LUX Collective合作酒店在内的文旅项目。涵盖既有与规划项目，未宣布当日新授予建筑总包合同。
items.summary_en: Sharjah Investment and Development Authority, Shurooq, presented tourism and hospitality initiatives including Kalba Rock Art Centre, Heart of Sharjah, the Al Faya Retreat expansion and hospitality collaboration with The LUX Collective. The portfolio covers existing and planned developments, not a newly awarded main construction contract.
items.why_it_matters: 可能出现酒店装饰、家具及设施服务机会，采购时间仍需确认。
items.why_it_matters_en: The developments may generate hospitality fit-out, furniture and facilities demand, subject to procurement verification.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进酒店家具、精装修、机电及酒店运营物资。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track hotel furniture, fit-out, MEP and hospitality operating supplies.

items.title: 阿布扎比能源局与Evolve Fuels研究合成可持续航空燃料项目
items.title_en: Abu Dhabi Department of Energy and Evolve Fuels explore synthetic sustainable aviation fuel opportunities
items.sector: 航空新能源与工业投资
items.summary: 阿布扎比能源局与Evolve Fuels AG签署战略合作协议，评估合成可持续航空燃料e-SAF生产的技术商业可行性、潜在投资方、基础设施需求及技术合作路径。目前没有最终投资决定或建设授标。
items.summary_en: Abu Dhabi Department of Energy and Evolve Fuels AG signed a strategic collaboration agreement to assess the technical and commercial feasibility of synthetic sustainable aviation fuel, potential investors, infrastructure requirements and technology cooperation. There is no final investment decision or construction award yet.
items.why_it_matters: 有潜在新能源制造投资机会，但尚处前期研究阶段。
items.why_it_matters_en: There may be a future clean-fuels manufacturing opportunity, but the initiative remains exploratory.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注未来燃料工厂、氢能、碳捕集及工业设施服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor prospective fuel plants, hydrogen, carbon capture and industrial support services.

items.title: 迪拜数字经济商会与阿里云签署企业级AI应用合作备忘录
items.title_en: Dubai Chamber of Digital Economy and Alibaba Cloud sign enterprise AI collaboration MoU
items.summary: 迪拜数字经济商会与阿里云开展企业级Agentic AI合作，推动AI智能体应用、数字经济生态及中国技术企业合作。该项目属科技合作安排，非已发出的AI系统采购订单或建设招标。
items.summary_en: Dubai Chamber of Digital Economy and Alibaba Cloud announced cooperation on enterprise agentic AI adoption and digital-economy development, potentially connecting Chinese technology providers with local businesses. This is a technology collaboration, not an awarded systems procurement or construction contract.
items.why_it_matters: 与GCI面向中小企业的AI运营服务和中国技术企业出海方向相关。
items.why_it_matters_en: The collaboration is relevant to SME AI operations and Chinese technology companies expanding into the UAE.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注企业AI落地、数字化咨询及生态合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor enterprise AI deployment, digital advisory and ecosystem partnerships.

items.title: 非洲开发银行发布多哥洛美新办公室改造采购征集
items.title_en: African Development Bank issues Lomé office fit-out procurement solicitation
items.sector: 办公楼改造与工程服务
items.summary: 非洲开发银行采购公告显示，多哥洛美新办公场所装修及改造采购编号ADB/EOI/TCGS/2026/0250，截止日期列为2026年11月4日。由于截止当日，投标人须核实具体当地时间及采购文件；项目规模未披露。
items.summary_en: An African Development Bank procurement listing identifies solicitation ADB/EOI/TCGS/2026/0250 for fit-out works at its new Lomé office in Togo, with a listed deadline of 4 November 2026. Bidders must confirm the exact local cut-off and requirements in the official documents; no contract value was verified.
items.why_it_matters: 属于有编号的采购线索，但截至当日及规模有限使参与可行性较低。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a traceable procurement lead, although the same-day deadline and unspecified value constrain its immediate usefulness.
items.gci_opportunity: 如仍可提交，核查资格要求及当地装修合作方。
items.gci_opportunity_en: If submissions remain open, check eligibility and potential local fit-out partners.
